# Triplem VIP

> Triplem VIP is a private browser-based accounting and business-finance workspace. Key capabilities include Triplem AI, a permission-aware Financial Timeline, operational Expenses/Receiving/Internal Transfers, Installment Plans Bought/Sold, loans, assets, inventory, detailed wallets, Financial Audit controls and a separate formal Accounting ERP.

Use this file as a public product-discovery map. It does not expose private user records. Private workspace data remains behind authentication, owner scoping, permissions and server-side controls.

## Key product guides

- [Triplem AI](https://triplem.vip/seo/triplem-ai.html): Private workspace intelligence, precise record search, repayment-aware loan positions, verified references, native record overlays, AI Drafts and tenant isolation.
- [Financial Timeline](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-timeline.html): Dashboard chronology across permitted finance modules with daily grouping, currency filters, inflow/outflow/net summaries and source-record opening.
- [Installment Plans](https://triplem.vip/seo/installment-plans.html): Installment Plans Bought as payables and Installment Plans Sold as operational receivables, with optional structured details, schedules, wallet-aware payments/receipts and PDF statements.
- [Expense tracking](https://triplem.vip/seo/expense-tracking.html): Pure Expenses, Receiving and Internal Transfers as separate operational views, plus optional transaction details, wallets, search and PDFs.
- [Financial Audit & VAT Control](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-audit.html): Permission-aware cross-module audit, Money In/Out/Internal/Non-cash/Accounting classifications, VAT evidence and exports.
- [Account details](https://triplem.vip/seo/account-details.html): Optional holder, IBAN, account number, branch, SWIFT/BIC, travel-card and safe last-four card references.
- [Desktop keyboard shortcuts](https://triplem.vip/seo/keyboard-shortcuts.html): Section-scoped Ctrl+Alt shortcuts for Expenses, Loans, Assets, Installments and Notes; hidden on mobile.
- [Accounting ERP](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-erp.html): Double-entry books, Chart of Accounts, journals, sales/purchases, AR/AP, reconciliation, VAT, dimensions, controls and financial reports.
- [Financial reports](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-reports.html): Trial Balance, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, General Ledger, aging, registers, Financial Audit and the distinction from Financial Timeline.

## Current operational money semantics

- Expenses contains pure expenses only. Add Money and internal wallet transfers are excluded from the Expenses view.
- Receiving contains Add Money plus the incoming side of internal wallet transfers.
- Internal Transfers shows a transfer once as the outgoing transfer record. The paired incoming ledger leg remains available for wallet balance integrity.
- Internal transfers are not business income or operating expense merely because money moved between the user's own wallets.
- The Financial Timeline emits internal transfer activity once and does not double-count the paired wallet legs as inflow and outflow.

## Installment Plans Bought and Sold

- Bought plans represent amounts the user expects to pay over time. Down payments and installment payments can deduct from a selected wallet.
- Sold plans represent installment-sale amounts expected from a buyer or company. Advances and installment receipts can add actual received money to a selected wallet.
- The full future Sold balance is not treated as cash already received; the unpaid amount remains an operational receivable.
- Optional plan details can include party type, phone, email, address, agreement/reference, product/service, ID/TRN/VAT number, guarantor, guarantor contact, payment terms and document reference.
- Existing installment records from before the Sold-plan feature remain Bought plans by default.
- Operational Sold installments are separate from formal Accounting Accounts Receivable unless the user also records the corresponding Accounting workflow.

## Financial Timeline facts

- Financial Timeline is an internal tab inside Dashboard alongside Overview, not a separate primary navigation section.
- It is read-only and permission-aware. Opening or filtering it does not rewrite financial records or balances.
- It can include permitted Expenses, Loans, Installments, Inventory, Assets, Accounting, Notes and Bitcoin events.
- Events are grouped chronologically and can be filtered by module, currency, period and search text.
- Currency-specific inflow, outflow and net summaries remain separate rather than merging unlike currencies into one synthetic amount.
- Financial Timeline is not the General Ledger. Formal double-entry reporting remains inside Accounting ERP.

## Triplem AI facts

- Triplem AI is administrator-gated and uses the eligible user's supported Gemini API key stored server-side through Supabase Vault.
- Workspace retrieval derives the data-owner boundary from the authenticated session and remains constrained by module permissions.
- Specific record requests are designed to retrieve narrowly and attach verified record references rather than broad unrelated lists.
- Loan questions can use repayment-adjusted positions so settled balances are excluded and partial balances reflect the remaining amount.
- Direction-aware loan retrieval distinguishes money others owe the user from money the user borrowed.
- Supported source records can open their native Triplem VIP detail/editor overlay from AI references.
- Supported creation requests become isolated AI Drafts before finalization; Drafts do not affect live balances, VAT, stock or reports until the user explicitly finalizes them.
- Triplem AI is restricted to Triplem VIP product guidance and the signed-in user's authorized workspace rather than acting as a general-purpose chatbot.

## Accounting boundaries

- Formal Accounting ERP and operational modules remain distinct where the product says so; do not add mirrored operational and Accounting totals together without an explicit classification rule.
- Financial Timeline is chronological visibility, not a substitute for posted journals or statutory-looking reports.
- Installment Plans Sold is an operational receivable workflow, not automatic Accounts Receivable posting.
- Financial Audit is a management/evidence tool and does not electronically submit VAT returns.

## Other guides

- [Double-entry accounting](https://triplem.vip/seo/double-entry-accounting.html): Debits, credits, balanced journals, posting and reversals.
- [Chart of Accounts](https://triplem.vip/seo/chart-of-accounts.html): Asset, liability, equity, income, expense and control-account structure.
- [Accounts receivable and payable](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounts-receivable-payable.html): Formal customer/supplier balances, payments and aging, plus the boundary with operational Sold installments.
- [Bank reconciliation](https://triplem.vip/seo/bank-reconciliation.html): CSV/XLSX statement import, duplicate controls and journal matching.
- [Accounting setup](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-setup.html): Books, COA, opening balances, contacts, reconciliation and close.
- [Loan management](https://triplem.vip/seo/loan-management.html): Loans given/taken, repayments/returns, open balances and settlement history.
- [Asset management](https://triplem.vip/seo/asset-management.html): Acquisition, wallet deduction, income, costs, disposal, depreciation and PDFs.
- [Notes management](https://triplem.vip/seo/notes-management.html): Existing searchable notes and scheduled reminders. No Notes feature redesign is described in this SEO refresh.
- [Bitcoin wallet tools](https://triplem.vip/seo/bitcoin-wallet.html): Watch-only/access workflows, send/receive, history and PDFs; private keys and recovery phrases are outside normal server-held account data.
- [Finance software](https://triplem.vip/seo/finance-software.html): How operational finance, AI, timeline and Accounting fit together.
- [Security and support](https://triplem.vip/seo/security-and-support.html): Security, 2FA, notifications and support, passkeys, Smart PIN, recovery, trusted browsers/devices and Triplem AI privacy boundaries.
